data.narrative:
Synchron is a Series D biotech company that has raised $200M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 private-sector comparables in the Biotech & Health space at the same or adjacent stage, alongside 3 public sector benchmarks (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D advancement, yielding $300M. Peer-median anchoring across the 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Abridge ($5.3B, Series E), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B, Series C)—produces a median valuation of $4.5B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable; the Biotech & Health sector median P/S multiple is 6.6x across three tickers, but Synchron's revenue is not on file. 

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range of $255M to $5.2B, with a median of $2.4B. The dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Synchron's clinical pipeline and intellectual property warrant valuation closer to earlier-stage peers or closer to more mature Series E comparables. Stage-progression alone suggests $300M; peer medians suggest $4.5B. Resolution will depend on Synchron's clinical readouts, revenue traction, and IP defensibility relative to the peer cohort.
